sec.title: Compound synthesis
sec.p: Synthetic Compound Alpha was prepared from the protected intermediate using 1gm, 0.2 vol and 5–50 μM at 3,200 × g overnight at room temperature; 2.5 g was held at 45 °C for 3 h and obtained in 80% yield.
Synthetic Compound Alpha was compared with placebo in a clinical cohort.

caption.p: The synthetic conversion leading to Synthetic Compound Alpha.
